subject: a crab carrying a stacked sorbet crown
pose: one claw lifted while the other supports the crown
art_direction: 粗像素螃蟹背着三层冰沙尖顶，橘粉青高对比色块形成古怪但可爱的中心角色。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a crab in deliberate coarse pixel art, carrying a three-tier sorbet crown on its shell. Use a limited palette of orange, dusty pink, mint, and deep periwinkle, with visible square pixels and no antialiased edges. One claw lifts in a proud gesture while the other steadies the leaning crown. The eyes are two small dark pixel clusters with clear highlights, giving the crab a cheeky expression. Keep the legs short and arranged as a compact base, not a wide horizontal spread. Place the centered character on a solid pale mint square, filling about seventy-five percent of the canvas. No text, game interface, familiar character design, or decorative pixel border.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
